summary: Iteration 2 regression + new-feature testing of DIVE demo (simulation persistence, richer holdings, share cards at Reveal & Insights, Manrope font). Backend 14/14 pytest passed; frontend end-to-end flow passed all critical checks.
critical_code_review_comments: diveEngine.effectiveHoldings look-through of simulated allocation is 100% 'Others (diversified)' — this is intentional for demo but be aware it inflates 'realDiversification' faster than real-world would.
Landing page tooltip decorations sit outside the phone frame — testing with data-testid nav buttons works reliably. No blocker.
test_credentials: None required — mock OTP via autofill-otp-btn (123456)

Score persists across nav-home <-> nav-xray <-> nav-suggestions. home-sim-banner appears exactly when sims non-empty and disappears on home-reset-sims.
